headline: China Mandates 70% Homegrown Silicon Wafer Use, Accelerating Tech Decoupling and Localizing AI Supply Chains
summary: This aggressive state-led industrial policy aims for critical self-sufficiency in foundational semiconductor components amidst global AI demand and export restrictions, directly intensifying geopolitical competition. It will significantly fragment global semiconductor supply chains, forcing the creation of parallel ecosystems and impacting international fab strategies for all major tech players.
